variants.headline: Still in view: party names a new leader
variants.sub: Leadership of {party} has changed, with {new} the new leader.
variants.body:
The party {party} has a new leader: {new}. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

New leader, with the same need for serious questions. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
